description: This file defines an interface Factory for creating various types of field expressions in the context of a query system. It provides methods for retrieving filter, exists, and sort expressions based on property names, potentially throwing exceptions if invalid property names are provided.

classes.name: FieldExpressionFactory
classes.description: A factory interface for obtaining field expressions used in querying, such as filtering, existence checking, and sorting, based on property names.

methods.name: filterBy
methods.description: Retrieves a filter field expression for the specified property name.

methods.name: existsBy
methods.description: Retrieves an exists field expression for the specified property name.

methods.name: sortBy
methods.description: Retrieves a sort field expression for the specified property name.
